verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own number provisioning (new or ported local or toll-free numbers, plus Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers), but the evidence only covers the US and Canada. Nothing shows per-country regulatory or documentation requirements being stated up front. missing for 10: number availability beyond US/Canada, per-country documentation/regulatory requirements disclosed before purchase, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front

citations.quote: One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere, with unlimited calls and texts to the US and Canada.
Set up a business number in minutes
